channel.title: Women's Wear Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Women's Wear Daily (wwd.com)

item.title: Ralph Lauren Fall 2026: Renaissance Man
item.description: Ralph Lauren found his sweet spot between the conceptual, commercial and red carpet with his rich, layered and luxurious fall collection.

item.title: Veronica Beard Fall 2026: Trailblazing
item.description: Inspired by trailblazing women from all industries and eras, the Veronica Beard fall collection was filled with Western-tinged details throughout their strong lineup of everyday wardrobing.

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Neutrogena Names Joey King Brand Ambassador
item.description: The announcement is coinciding with the release of the skin care brand's new Evenly Clear Collection.

item.title: Front Row Acquires Marketing Agency Socium Media
item.description: The deal marks Front Row's second acquisition in a year.

item.title: Spanx Relaunches Swimwear Collection With Three Different Compression Levels
item.description: The brand brings its expertise in fit and function to the category.

item.title: How ‘The Devil Wears Prada’ Sequel Inspired Pantone’s NYFW Fashion Color Trend Report for Fall 2026
item.description: The anticipated film inspired the combinations in the trend report, with the juxtaposition of "power colors" alongside vintage influences and the occasional pops of vibrancy.

item.title: Chubbies to Launch Women’s Swim Line Cheekies
item.description: The initial collection of 10 pieces will be sold online and at Dick's Sporting Goods.

item.title: American Eagle Taps Country Music Singer-Songwriter Ella Langley for Spring Ad Campaign
item.description: Langley will attend Stagecoach Music Festival in April, which American Eagle is sponsoring.

item.title: Starbucks’ Deepening Ties to Fashion
item.description: Tressie Lieberman, chief global brand officer at Starbucks, said, "Tapping into cultural relevance matters more than ever."

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Fashion Designers Willy Chavarria and Sandy Liang at Home for DWR’s Originals Campaign
item.description: The furniture, accessories and lighting retailer spotlights Chavarria and Liang as authentic voices shaping design.
